meta.title: Clean positive with a salary range entirely above both thresholds

payload.requisition_text:
Backend Engineer (Go)
Redegate Software Ltd — Edinburgh or remote (UK)

Redegate runs the booking infrastructure behind 300 UK tour and activity operators. August is our Black Friday, every day.

You'd join a six-person backend team working in Go and Postgres on availability search, payments reconciliation and the public API. We deploy on merge and keep a written decision log.

Requirements: 2+ years of production backend work in any typed language, and a worked example of an API you made faster or simpler.

The band is £40,000-£48,000 depending on level. Visa sponsorship is available; we currently sponsor three of the team. 33 days holiday including public holidays. One pairing interview, one systems conversation, offers within a week.

expected.determining_fact: Redegate Software Ltd holds an A-rated Skilled Worker licence, sponsorship is offered, and the whole band (£40,000-£48,000) clears both thresholds.

evidence_anchors.willingness_quote: Visa sponsorship is available; we currently sponsor three of the team

design_notes: Range variant of the clean positive: pass is definitive because the band minimum (40,000) clears the going rate with 1,700 of margin. Distinguishes solvers that evaluate range minima from those that anchor on the maximum.
